decision.title: Elvis' Gold Records Volume 4 (1968)
tracklist: Please Don't Drag That String Around
Just Tell Her Jim Said Hello

rationale: Discography populator: full tracklist (12 tracks) per https://www.discogs.com/release/2192724-Elvis-Presley-Elvis-Gold-Records-Volume-4?redirected=true, https://citizendium.org/wiki/Elvis%27_Gold_Records,_Volume_4. 1968 RCA Victor compilation (LSP-3921/LPM-3921) of 1961-1967 singles: 5 A-sides and 7 B-sides. 12-track sequence identical across Discogs US pressing, Citizendium and RareVinyl UK listing. The withdrawn UK sleeve (RD-7924) misprints 'Love Letters' as 'Never Ending' on the front cover; the vinyl track is 'Love Letters'.
